description: Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - Amend the rules under regulation of Insurance Act, published Gaz. Ex. No. 1412/30 to increase the registration fee
reasoning: This gazette content contains a rule made by the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It specifically amends existing regulations by changing monetary thresholds. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and amendments to existing regulations governing the insurance industry.
